operators.name: attention_forward
semantics: Performs MultiheadAttention forward with batch_first=True, default args: no key_padding_mask, need_weights=True, attn_mask=None, average_attn_weights=True, is_causal=False.

Query, key, value are projected using in_proj_weight and in_proj_bias: q = query @ W_q^T + b_q, k = key @ W_k^T + b_k, v = value @ W_v^T + b_v, where W_q, W_k, W_v are the three chunks of in_proj_weight.
Each head splits the projected tensors into num_heads heads of dimension E/num_heads.
Scaled dot-product attention: scores = q @ k^T / sqrt(E/num_heads), softmax over last dim, then attn = softmax(scores) @ v.
Heads are concatenated and projected: attn_output = concat_heads @ out_proj_weight^T + out_proj_bias.
Attention weights are averaged over heads and returned as shape [B, L, L].

operators.name: transpose_3d
semantics: Returns a new tensor with dimensions [B, E, L] by transposing dims 1 and 2 of input.
Equivalent to x.transpose(1,2) in PyTorch. The output is a view with appropriate strides, not necessarily contiguous, but subsequent matmul will handle non-contiguous input if necessary.

operators.name: batched_matmul
semantics: Performs batched matrix multiplication: out[b] = a[b] @ b[b] for each batch index b.
Equivalent to torch.matmul(a, b) for 3D tensors with matching batch dimensions.

Inputs are expected to be contiguous; the transpose_3d output may be non-contiguous, so this op should handle non-contiguous b by making it contiguous internally, or the model should call .contiguous() on transposed value first. To avoid torch ops, we assume batched_matmul accepts a non-contiguous tensor and internally handles it via explicit strides or a copy in the CUDA implementation.
Calls MultiheadAttention forward with batch_first=True, no masks, need_weights=True, average_attn_weights=True.
Returns a tuple: attn_output of shape [32,1024,128] and attn_weights of shape [32,1024,1024].
In debug_forward, this step yields the tuple (attn_output, attn_weights).
Computes batched matmul between attention output x [B, L, E] and transposed value [B, E, L] to produce output shape [B, L, L].
Final return is a tensor of shape [32,1024,1024].
